column1: # Phase 3 gate (2026-10-21): the fire-sale bank with an unobserved fundamental.
# The shock-size gate could not pass (docs/pilot_map.md F8): every decision state
# already contains the shock. Here theta ~ U[0,1] per run sets the long asset's
# return R(theta) = 1.0 + 0.4 theta, and agents either know only the prior (none) or
# Balance sheet (Chapter 1 baseline, Rochet-Vives): reserves r 0.05, the rest plus
# equity e 0.06 in the long asset, sold at discount d 0.6; stayers are promised
# R = 1.1 x deposit and the bank fails if it cannot pay them at period 2. With these
# values theta_L ~ 0.10 (fails with no withdrawals) and A*(theta) runs from 0.05 to
# 0.20 of deposits, the range of the cascades a local smoke run produced. (A first
# calibration, r 0.10 / d 0.5 / e 0.08, put A* at 0.13-0.32: a smoke cell at sigma
# 2.5 failed only in the dominance region, P(run) 0.06.)
# Two deposit dispersions: sigma 2.5 (Celsius-matched, F7: whales present) and 1
# (no whales), same cell otherwise (k 6, p 0.05, q 0, alpha 0.1, mu 0.5, lambda
# (0.1, 0.9)), 250 runs per arm. Single-cell arms at seed offset 1000: the same five
# initialisations per sigma, and theta is shared run for run across the four arms.
# Read: python3 scripts/theta_response.py outputs/p3-s25-* (and outputs/p3-s1-*)
# PASS: P(run) falls with theta more steeply as s shrinks (slope none > s20 > s10 > s05
# in magnitude, i.e. most negative at s 0.05). Also read failType shares and
# largestWithdrew at sigma 2.5 vs 1.
